ops.body:
Coordinator: synckit cc-sync/artifact-delivery @ 4334f0d (PR #4 draft, CI green, body updated). It now carries two policy changes and a wire change.
- **Restriction epoch.** netpolicy State.RestrictedEpoch counts every restriction, including ones that clear before the next read. Manual-setting saves are published promptly (directory watch plus 1s re-check). An edit mark survives deletion of the setting file.
- **Mid-transfer pauses:**
  - sender side: watchLocal pauses a transfer with 'local: restricted mid-transfer';
  - receiver side (found by review): have / batch.begin / batch.put / batch.commit / apply.v2 refuse, before decoding, when the receiver's epoch has moved since the admitted one.
- **Wire change, disclosed for the final report.** restricted_epoch and 'admitted' now cross the wire and batch.commit can return Paused. There is no compat shim, so both peers need this build. Acceptable because the feature is unreleased; it goes in the report.
- **Review:** a code review of the receiver-side repair is running (Run wf_b8a2a822-2dd).
- **Follow-up, out of scope:** netpolicy.Gate.Check has no in-repo callers and only compares the local epoch.
- **Next for cc-sync:** the final re-pin to 4334f0d (or the post-review head), fetch-policy eb16960 with the netgate epoch, and the reposync final. That needs the reposync final-review fixes to land first.
